papers.title_in_file: Geometric spectral theory of quantum graphs
papers.version_note: Text layer is the published Communications in Mathematics 32 (2024) copy of arXiv:2310.02707v3; single copy, not duplicated.
papers.what_it_is: Lecture notes on the dependence of Laplacian eigenvalues on the geometry of a compact metric graph (Nicaise, Friedlander and surgery-based eigenvalue bounds).
papers.why_not: The paper is pure mathematics: spectral theory of differential operators (Laplacians) on metric graphs, called quantum graphs. It contains no quantum computing, quantum machine learning, machine learning, finance or evaluation-method content; its eigenvalue theorems (Nicaise, Friedlander, surgery principles) concern diffusion on graphs of fixed total length. The store holds no assertions from it, so there are no verdicts to give, and no assertion is entered.
